report.summary: The report's sourcing is generally sound. Out of 51 tagged claims, 50 are fully supported and 1 is partial (RMC plant location 'Kashimira' cited to drhp-p63, which only mentions Thane; the location is actually in drhp-p67). One untagged claim in the opening paragraph could benefit from a citation. No unsupported or wrong-source claims were identified, so the blocking count is zero.

untagged_claims.sentence: A B Infrabuild Limited is a Mumbai-based infrastructure contractor and ready-mix concrete manufacturer whose business depends almost entirely on winning government tenders — especially from Indian Railways.
